title: Protocol for ex vivo time lapse imaging of Drosophila melanogaster cytonemes
protocol: Clean all dissection tools with 70% ethanol and allow ethanol to fully evaporate.
Select larvae of the desired genotype for dissection.
Place selected larvae in a cell strainer.
Rinse larvae with 70% ethanol, then rinse with sterile water.
Transfer larvae to a dissection dish containing sterile culture media.
Dissect larvae under a stereoscope using two fine forceps.
Cut larvae in half to preserve the anterior section containing the mouth hocks.
Grab the mouth hooks with one forceps.
Gently push the larval body wall with the second forceps towards the mouth hooks, flipping the cuticle inside-out.
Carefully remove fat body, gut, and ventral nerve cord (VNC), leaving imaginal discs and trachea.
Place 20 μL of media in the middle of the μ-Dish.
Transfer the cleaned sample to the μ-Dish.
Dissect the two wing discs from the carcass while preserving as much attached trachea as possible.
Place the wing disc with the side attached to trachea oriented down, in contact with the glass surface.
Carefully place the pre-assembled 3D ring on top of the 20 μL drop of medium or place the membrane over the drop and attach to the double-sided tape spacers.
Add 2 mL of media to the μ-Dish.
Close the lid.
Dissect the wing disc quickly without touching or pinching it.
Transfer the sample to a 20 μL drop of media in the culture dish.
Cut indicated tracheas and release the wing imaginal disc.
Place the tissue with the trachea facing the glass bottom.
Place the 35 mm μ-Dish containing the sample on the stage of an inverted microscope.
Locate the wing disc and choose the appropriate objective.
Select an oil immersion objective for imaging.
Use a laser suitable for excitation (e.g., 488 nm for GFP).
Set low laser power to minimize phototoxicity.
Adjust detection voltage gain to ensure detectable structures of ASP cells.
Choose the lowest pixel resolution allowing visualization of cytonemes.
Acquire z-stack images covering the entire depth of ASP.
Crop to an area including ample space around ASP.
Set acquisition time for each z-stack less than one minute.
Reduce cropped area or z-stack depth if acquisition takes longer than one minute.
Set total acquisition time interval greater than or equal to the sum of all z-stack acquisition times.
